last_episode_to_air.name: The Wrap-up of Season Three
last_episode_to_air.overview: The E-caders are ready to wrap up Earth Arcade 3 with a big gonggi battle with everything on the line. While the members’ wish will be granted if they win, the staff prepares an even bigger penalty for their loss that shocks the team. After coming back to Korea, the E-caders hold a bizarre rooftop party to celebrate the end of the season and play a game of curling to determine who will get to keep what from their journey in Portugal.

name: Earth Arcade
overview: Four warriors who gathered to catch the moon rabbit who fled to Earth! A new concept hybrid multiverse action adventure variety that unfolds across time and space begins!

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The rabbit "Ok Armstrong", who works at a rice cake shop in the space, escapes to the Earth. The Great Jade Emperor, who owns the shop, gets mad and turns on Instagram Live saying that "I will reward whoever catches Ok Armstrong!" ; Four heroes Lee Eun-ji, Mimi, Lee Young-ji, and An Yu-jin gather aiming to get a reward. A new concept hybrid multiverse action adventure variety that unfolds acorss time and space begins.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Lee Eun-ji, Mimi, Lee Young-ji, and An Yujin, whose amazing synergy brought great laughter to audiences in season 1, are reuniting once again, this time in Finland and Bali. The four will deliver unexpected entertainment in this unique variety show that combines action, adventure, and different dimensions.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The four Earth Warriors are back on a mission to catch Torong, who stole the Jade Emperor's corporate card and bolted to Earth! A new ally 'Agent F' joins the squad to save the day...! Get ready for a third epic adventure in Abu Dhabi's golden desert and Portugal's charming streets!
